s: the fruit of the tree is most sweet (above all previously tasted fruit)

s: Lehi prophesies about the seed of Lehi

s: Nephi is a record keeper (writing on the plates)

s: Nephi desires to know these things (by the power of the Holy Ghost)

s: the Holy One of Israel redeems the children of men (from their lost and fallen state)

s: the Spirit and power of God is a gift of God (given to those who diligently seek him)

s: baptism of the Messiah uses water

s: crucifixion of Jesus Christ is for sin (the sins of the world)

s: resurrection of Jesus Christ follows crucifixion of Jesus Christ (after Jesus Christ was slain)
q: And after they had slain the Messiah, who should come, and after he had been slain he should rise from the dead

q: which covenant the Lord made to our father Abraham, saying: In thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

l: The First Book of Nephi, His Reign and Ministry
s: the scattering of Israel is caused by the Gentiles (before the latter-day restoration)
q: and he meaneth that it will not come to pass until after they are scattered by the Gentiles;

l: The First Book of Nephi, His Reign and Ministry
s: gathering of Israel occurs after the scattering of Israel (in the latter days)
q: and he meaneth that it will not come to pass until after they are scattered by the Gentiles;

l: The First Book of Nephi, His Reign and Ministry
s: the three days' journey into the wilderness is commanded by the Lord (to begin on the morrow)
q: and commanded him that on the morrow he should take his journey into the wilderness.
